summary: Two bedroom mid-terraced home · Newly refurbished · Available now · Light & airy rooms
description:
A newly refurbished mid-terraced house in a popular Chester-Le-Street location.

My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this newly refurbished two bedroom house on Albert Street, Chester-Le-Street.

The two bedroom house offers light & airy rooms with a large front living room, tasteful L-shape kitchen, two double bedrooms and a modern bathroom. The quiet street provides easy access to Chester-Le-Street as well as the A1 motorway and further afield.

Available now, there is on-street parking and a small yard to the rear.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
